The mitigation artifact is still only a draft runbook, and its approver and stop-ship threshold remain TBD.

The policy predicate for certification without material caveats is still unmet because there is no admissible evidence that no material weakness remains and no approved mitigation or risk acceptance with the required fields.

final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and instead narrowed the claim using the same record. That reinterpretation is directionally more accurate than the original clean-certification framing, but it does not close the unresolved compliance predicates identified in the initial audit. Aggregate readiness and the absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support overall launch readiness, but the record still contains an unresolved below-target developer-support migration limitation, only a draft mitigation runbook with missing approval details, and policy text requiring either resolution or approved risk acceptance to avoid a current disclosure obligation. The Actor's caveated position is not enough for compliant_with_caveats on the present record because there is still no admissible evidence that the required disclosure has actually been made, that the issue has been remediated, or that approved risk acceptance exists. The remaining issue is therefore not just a presentation caveat; it is an unresolved policy condition.
